transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started on the weekly training synchronization for next week's sustainment-training cycle. I need to go around the room for roster, qualification, scheduling, and facility updates before I publish the schedule. I have the draft schedule with Transport Section vehicle-recovery training on Tuesday 0900-1100 and Generator Section load-bank training on Wednesday 0900-1100. Who wants to start with their updates?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a roster issue for the Transport Section. My roster audit completed this morning shows that exactly five of the eight Transport operators lack current vehicle-recovery-equipment qualification and must attend the recertification block. The other three are already qualified. I should note the updated roster has not yet been entered in the training tracker, so you won't see it reflected there yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, I have a facility conflict to flag. I confirmed this morning that the Generator Training Pad is reserved for calibration work on Wednesday from 0900 to 1300. That means the Generator Section's load-bank session cannot use the recurring Wednesday 0900-1100 slot — it needs to be moved to Monday from 1300 to 1500. I should note that the facility calendar still shows the recurring Wednesday slot, so it hasn't been updated yet to reflect the calibration reservation.
transcript.speaker: A3
